about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Huang left as CEO on 12 Nov (ousted per Bloomberg, resigned per TechCrunch); Colette Kress is interim CEO; Joon H. Kim leads an independent investigation; earnings due 17 Nov.
Roadshow began 10 Nov at $70 to $78 a share for 825m shares; pricing expected 18 Nov and first trade 19 Nov; reported valuations range from $1.02tn to $1.4tn.
Putin met Witkoff and Kushner on 12 Nov; prisoner exchange called finalised but no numbers; Europe to join next round; UK, France and Germany meet in Berlin next week.
Trump said on 12 Nov the US does not need a deal; Rezaei denies talks; reports of a possible Vance-Rezaei meeting in Doha.
Burnham said on 9 Nov that no decision had been made; reports of a cut to about 60% for 2030; outcome of the 11 Nov meeting still not confirmed.
Eisenkot has the mandate to form a government; mandate runs to 6 Dec; Haredi parties reportedly fielding overtures.
Brazil package carries the 2027 front-wing concept; more aero updates expected in Las Vegas.
Antonelli has the drivers' title and Mercedes the constructors'; Las Vegas race 04:00 UK on 22 Nov; 2027 grid set apart from one Cadillac seat.
Honda has no root cause for Stroll's battery failures; countermeasure needed before Las Vegas, full fix targeted for 2027.
Anthropic Mythos 5.2, OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber and Google Gemini 4 Carbon all have restricted cyber variants.
Runs to 20 Nov; Burnham spoke on 12 Nov and reaffirmed net zero by 2050; Rosebank decision pending.
BMA consultants voted for a 48-hour strike on 25 to 26 Nov; one undated report says it is paused for formal talks, unconfirmed.
Brussels summit on 20 Nov; Burnham met von der Leyen in Dublin; agreements on food, emissions trading and youth mobility reportedly due.
Further unauthenticated root PoCs published 11 Nov; vendor says scanning but no successful exploitation; another hotfix expected.
